author: jracer15
body: I have been working on this new walls map called Utopia.  Its a future themed walls and I going to add teleporting stations.  In case your wondering if this will make the map less survival like no worries, I'm going to add a whole other place thats more survival like the upper class sent all the lower class to live in and include mine shaft!

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body: Looks rather empty, flat and blocky. I'd include more structures and interesting places to visit on the map. Futuristic themed maps are difficult to make, and specially under Walls category. Anyways, I can't help you much on this, so try and find a way to add the correct amount of resources to it (water, ores, food, wood, chests) and it should be fine. Good luck!
